node.runtime: Rust -> WASM (Node, browser, edge); build-time Vite/remark compiler
node.notes: Rust port of Pele: source comments explicitly attribute the flowchart, sequence, class, layered/compound layout and SVG builder implementations. Separate git root from Pele. Targets Mermaid 12.1.0 syntax. Node uses a speed-optimized all-types WASM module; browsers can load size-optimized per-family or all-types WASM. The mount-only runtime inserts precompiled SVG and is not a renderer. Image Worker also serves PNG via rasterization. Published 0.0.1 is pinned for benchmarks; source manifest is already 0.0.2. npm provenance commit was verified as an ancestor of the inspected main. Inspected 0.0.2 source adds CLI --ascii by projecting compiled SVG to cells; this unpublished terminal surface was not benchmarked.
